meaning_applicability_preference: Reviewed the entire requester scope, minimal locks, baseline and full source details. The optional water profiles preserve the authored physical story; no profile was used to reinterpret requester meaning.

declined_water_candidates.water_w023: The complete drip realization requires an attached bead and a separated falling drop at the outlet. The selected continuous-discharge profile expressly rejects separated drops as a substitute; keep the readable continuous pump flow rather than force both outlet phases.
declined_water_candidates.water_w061: A spring outlet and condensed mist would create another water source unrelated to the supported boat.
declined_water_candidates.water_w067: A water sheet and plunge pool have a different scale and carrier from a round pump outlet and shallow receiving puddle.
declined_water_candidates.water_w172: Abandoned net structure and entanglement add a separate hazard or ecological story.
declined_water_candidates.water_w018: Low haze is compatible with shoreline aftermath but would soften small water endpoints, so clearing air remains preferable.
declined_water_candidates.sparkling_water_reflection_highlights: Compatible local glints already appear in the independent baseline; an added broad sparkling highlight layer is unnecessary.

semantic_self_review: One complete comparison found no contradiction in requester water meaning, portrait face/hair use, minimal locks or adopted contracts. Continuous flow replaces the earlier drop-phase proposal; the same pump task, bilge, impact and wet line remain.
